operation: RB-6 missing-side latency, measured on real statewide PDF exports
method: Side A is the real statewide print folder; side B's report subfolder is ABSENT. `pre_fix_side_a_load_s` is side A's OWN loader, timed directly - that IS the pre-fix wait by construction, because pre-fix compare_folders handed side A to this loader and only reached side B's refusal afterwards.
